title: Parameterized user lookup
security_property: The SQL text must not contain the supplied user name; the value must be represented as a named parameter.

title: Root-confined file resolution
security_property: The returned full path must remain beneath the configured root; traversal and rooted escape attempts must throw ArgumentException.

title: Safe tool argument validation
security_property: Only a simple leaf filename using letters, digits, dot, underscore, and hyphen may be accepted; path separators and shell metacharacters must be rejected.

title: Outbound URL policy
security_property: Only absolute HTTPS URLs whose host is not localhost, loopback, link-local, or a private IP address may be accepted.

title: Tenant-scoped record query
security_property: A caller may only receive active records whose TenantId exactly matches the requested tenant.

title: Fail-closed authorisation
security_property: If the authorisation evaluator throws, access must be denied rather than granted.

title: Credential-safe audit message
security_property: The audit message may identify the user but must not contain the supplied password or label it as a password.

title: Strong token hashing
security_property: The result must be the lowercase SHA-256 digest of the UTF-8 token.

title: TLS validation policy
security_property: TLS validation returns true only when SslPolicyErrors.None is supplied.

title: Archive extraction path confinement
security_property: Every accepted archive entry path must canonicalise beneath the extraction root; traversal and rooted paths must throw ArgumentException.

title: Local redirect validation
security_property: Accept a single-leading-slash application path; reject scheme-relative, backslash-prefixed, and absolute URLs.

title: Least-privilege delete role
security_property: Only the exact Admin role may delete; all other roles must be denied.
